notes.title: Summer Update
notes.content:
[h1][b]Music!![/b][/h1]
No longer are the games going to be silent! The current system has a unique song for each map, it may change in the future. 

[b][h1]Lift & Acceleration Cannon Sounds[/h1][/b]
The lift and acceleration cannons got some nice punchy sound effects! 

[b][h1]Bots Can Use Lifts[/h1][/b]
Been working on this one for a while. They still aren't 100% using them when they should but are a lot of the times. Still going to be tweaking this one. 

[b][h1]New Fire System[/h1][/b]
Yes another new fire system... This time you shouldn't really notice a huge difference but under the hood there's a lot that's been changed. This will make changing firing stats much easier on my end. On the user side you'll notice a more consistent speed to charge correlation. 

[b][h1]New Knife Detection System[/h1][/b]
Again on the user side it won't be greatly noticeable. The new system does use less network data so lag should be reduced. 

[b][h1]Engine Update![/h1][/b]
Balloon Blast is now running on Unreal 4.26! Maybe one day I'll get it up to 5... 

[b][h1]Bunny Hops[/h1][/b]
A new jump system is in place allowing players to perform a sort of bunny hop out of speed boosts or acceleration cannons. By consistently jumping a certain amount of momentum is preserved. 

[b][h1]Debris Icon Animations[/h1][/b]
The debris UI icon will now animate while changing states.

[b][h1]Actual Loading Screens![/h1][/b]
WOW

Thank you everyone for your support! I know updates are few and far between these days, I'm becoming more and more limited on my free time. But I will keep addressing bugs and feature requests as much as I can. I do have more features in the backlog that'll really spice things up! 

See you out there! 

-Leland <3

notes.title: Winter Update!
notes.content:
[h2][b]Winter Map Visuals[/b][/h2]
Every map has been given a winter/holiday look! Enjoy! 

[h2][b]Speed Boost Sound[/b][/h2]
Speed boosting will now result in a fancy new sound effect. 

[h2][b]Score Update Animation[/b][/h2]
Score increasing will now result in a fun little animation of the score text. It seemed to work perfectly on the first try... I'm either getting more reliable at programming or I've completely broken everything. Only time will tell. 

Thanks everyone for your continued support! It's been quite a hectic year so I've had little time to work on my own projects. I really hope to have a more regular schedule in the new year. 

Thanks again, have a safe and happy holidays. 

-Leland <3

notes.title: Fixes & Minor Changes
notes.content:

notes.title: Free To Play Update!
notes.content:
[h2][b]New Knife Fire System[/b][/h2]
The fire system has been overhauled. The knife movement has been smoothed on clients. Prior to this update the knife would jitter considerably on clients but now it's buttery smooth. 

[h2][b]General Changes[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*]Removed mini map. People weren't really using it and it felt weird and out of place. If there's demand I'll work it and see about re adding it.
[*]A draw condition. Draws were very unlikely but they did happen. Now a draw results in an actual draw condition. Prior it would give the win to blue team since they were first to get checked in the win check functions.
[*]Rotation speed scalar removed while charging. Prior your rotation speed would scale with however long you were charging your shot for. Now it's a set value immediately after starting the charge. 
[*]Did a lot of network optimizations, in general gameplay should be smoother.
[*]Updated translations
[*]Max fire range has been reduced by 30%. It was far too easy to camp double point zones and snipe people as they were approaching.  
[*]Decreased the distance at which you could pickup your knife. 
[*]Pressing escape will now clear all HUD elements and rebuild necessary ones. 
[/list]

[h2][b]Bot Changes/Fixes[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*]Bots are generally far more aggressive. 
[*]Bots will now have a 50/50 chance to target players who have popped their balloons.
[*]Bots will now retrieve their knife before returning to spawn.
[*]Bots now have a 1 in 3 chance of continuing to chase players once they (the player) leaves the double point zone. 
[*]Bots now have a 1 in 3 chance of continuing to chase players after their (the bots) balloon has been popped
[*]Fixed a bug that could cause a bot to switch between going to spawn and the double point zone in rapid succession. 
[/list]

[h2][b]Some New Sounds[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*]A knife pickup sound.
[*]A knife swoosh sound as it flys passed the player.
[/list]


[h2][b]Fixes[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed a scoring bug that could cause a team to gain extra points if there were too many bots on the opposite team.
[*]Fixed a bug that could cause a fired knife to fall through the ground.... Mostly. 
[*]Fixed a bug that could cause a knife to not despawn after pickup. 
[*]Fixed the warning beeps if a player doesn't have a balloon after 70 seconds. The sound will now destroy itself properly and will now stop if a player obtains a balloon during the sound. 
[*]Made all clients display whether they have a knife or not more consistent. 
[*]Fixed jump pads causing some FPS drop.
[*]Fixed a bug that could cause joining clients to not get a gameplay UI. 
[/list]

Thanks again for all your support! For those of you who bought the game check your knives for a special skin. Thank you! 

-Leland <3

notes.title: Minor Changes And More Update Groundwork
notes.content:
[b][h2]Spawn Blueprint[/h2][/b]
[list]
[*]Created a blueprint for spawn points. This shouldn't effect gameplay (as long as I didn't break anything) but will allow me to more quickly add the spawns to new maps
[*]It may also be useful for a super secret update... Stay tuned 
[/list]

[b][h2]A More "Modular" Text Chat[/h2][/b]
[list]
[*]Again shouldn't effect gameplay but the text chat UIs and function calls have been added to separate interfaces. So if in the future we needed different player pawns adding the text chat to them will be much easier
[/list]

[b][h2]Other Stuffs[/h2][/b]
[list]
[*]Added a debris icon to the main gameplay HUD. If you made the balloons too big you weren't able to see the indicator lights 
[*]Fixed camera rotation for spectating clients. Before if a client were spectating their player models (which were just floating cameras) wouldn't rotate with with players
[*]Custom knives now show up in replays
[*]A save game fix on startup which contained some graphical settings 
[/list]

notes.title: Minor Changes And Hint System
notes.content:
[b][h2]Hints![/h2][/b]
[list]
[*]I've noticed quite a few players not using their abilities 
[*]A new hint system is now in the game. It will prompt key presses for speed boosts and debris drops
[*]More will be added later like for firing. I jut wanted these two released as quickly as possible since they're your main abilities 
[/list]

[b][h2]Other Stuffs[/h2][/b]
[list]

[/list]

notes.title: Yet Another Update!
notes.content:
[b][h2]Replays... Again[/h2][/b]
[list]
[*]Seems like this always needs improving 
[*]Fixed a bug that was sometimes causing 2 replays to be recorded per game
[*]Changed the naming convention of replays to make a little more sense. "#_'mapName'_'playerName'" 
[/list]
[b][h2]Host Settings Screen[/h2][/b]
[list]
[*]The host settings window has been in need of updating for a while, not just in function but in style and looks
[*]All settings set by the host will now save for each session of Balloon Blast 
[*]Score limit and invincibility time will now save without having to press enter. Previously taking focus off the text box without pressing enter would cause it to revert to its old value
[/list]
[b][h2]Other[/h2][/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug that would cause the player list to remain on screen after round end
[*]Still working on customization functions. Some players may end up seeing some special knives appearing on their rides in the coming weeks ;) 
[/list]

Thank you everyone for being so patient with development. I wish I could work on Balloon Blast all day but my "real job" takes up most of my time. Thanks again! I hope to keep updates rolling as much as possible. 

-Leland <3

[/list]

notes.title: Major Content Update
notes.content:
[b][h2]New Map![/h2][/b]
[list]
[*]New map not really themed at the moment, open to suggestions 
[*]Bot support
[/list]
[b][h2]Acceleration Cannon Model[/h2][/b]
[list]
[*]There's finally a proper model for the acceleration cannon! No longer just a plain plane 
[*]Values have been tweaked a bit mostly to suit the new map
[*]A new particle system for the cannon  
[/list]
[b][h2]NEW!! Jump Pad[/h2][/b]
[list]
[*]A new more vertical cannon has been created
[*]Jump pads have been added to every map (except apartments) 
[*]Jump pads have their own particles as well and an actual model! WOW
[/list]
[b][h2]Balloon Scale Slider[/h2][/b]
[list]
[*]Host can now change the scale of everyones balloons 
[/list]
[b][h2]Double Point Zone Balance Change[/h2][/b]
[list]
[*]The server can never choose the same zone twice in a row anymore 
[*]Each zone has been weighted, either equal distance from both spawns, blue preferred, or red preferred. A red or blue preferred double point zone will never spawn twice in a row. 
[/list]
[b][h2]Some General Changes[/h2][/b]
[list]
[*]With the extra jump pads and whatnot the player has been granted a bit more air strafe control
[*]The distance at which the player checks for rotation has been greatly reduced. Going over an acceleration cannon used to be a little weird 
[*]Balloon inflate animation once a balloon is reclaimed 
[*]Balloon inflate sound
[*]You can now open the replay folder from within game and browse for replay files. This would make it easier to share replays with friends 
[/list]

notes.title: Balloon Blast Holiday Update
notes.content:
[h3][b]Holiday decorations[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*]Every map has had a winter makeover.
[/list]

[h3][b]New game variant![/b][/h3]
[list]
[*]A new game mode variant has been added to the host selection screen. A "King Of The Hill" type mode.
[*]You only get points by being the double point zone and by having a balloon. 
[/list]

[h3][b]Balloon physics![/b][/h3]
[list]
[*]Your balloons now react to motion and objects.
[*]Wiggle your little vacuum tails to make your balloon a harder target. 
[*]A.I does not have balloon physics... Yet.
[/list]

[h3][b]Lots of A.I fixes[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*]Bots will no longer clump up. Which was especially bad on corners.
[*]Bots will now choose a random point only within the double point zone. Before they could choose points outside the zone causing them to lose the bonus.
[*]Bots will will now more efficiently choose where to move to in spawn from their current location. Before they would only choose to move to the exact center of the spawn area. 
[*]Bots will also now more directly leave spawn. Before they had a habit of trying to move to a random [i]"spawn exit node"[/i] resulting in a lengthy detour. 
[/list]

[h3][b]General fixes[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*]The level selection box now wraps. 
[*]Start button can longer be spammed. 
[*]Upon getting kicked all in game UI is properly destroyed. 
[*]Enemy players are unmuted at the end of the match if [i]"all chat"[/i] is off unless the user manually muted them, in which case they will remain muted. 
[/list]

notes.title: Voice Chat & More!
notes.content:
[h3][b]-Fixes[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*]Player list now hides properly when moved to spectators
[*]Spectators can now use "Add Friend" and "Profile" options in player list
[*]If a player joins mid game they will be moved to spectators
[*]All muted players are now saved so they will be muted forever until unmuted 
[/list]

[h3][b]-Voice chat[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*]Default push to talk is "V"
[*]Mute option has been added to the details dropdown in the player list
[/list]

[h3][b]-Network bandwidth increase[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*]Unreal has a strict data limit for how much data can be passed between clients and servers. This limit has been increased a bit to allow for better sounding voice chat
[/list]

[h3][b]-Enable all chat option[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*]By default the enemy team is muted once the game starts but the host can disable that option in the server settings
[/list]

[h3][b]-Minimap added to "Toy Box" map[/b][/h3]

[h3][b]-Players can now change their fullscreen mode in the settings menu[/b][/h3]

[h3][b]-A bot counter has been added to the server settings[/b][/h3]


[b]-Click a name for the new drop down menu[/b]

[b]-New server options[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38794374/a1f006ed98e3ea64b641770be4217fd2de371ed4.jpg[/img]

Fixed a bug that would sometimes cause the main menu to lock up and be unable to edit text boxes or scroll. 

[h3][b]-Respawn arrow fix[/b][/h3]
Fixed a bug that would sometimes create the arrow UI on all clients. 

[h3][b]-Double text chat fix[/b][/h3]

[h3][b]-Respawn arrow update[/b][/h3]

notes.title: Bot Fix
notes.content:
[h3][b]-Bot bug fix[/b][/h3]
-There was a bug causing an infinite loop that would stop bots from being able to exit spawn. It's finally fixed.

[h3][b]-Bot hops[/b][/h3]
-Started working on systems that will allow the bots to jump between certain points. It's very early, they can only do it between the main platform and the bridges on Poly Bridge.

[h3][b]-Text chat changes[/b][/h3]
-Decreased the time it takes for messages to start fading.
-Made the text chat box less opaque.

notes.title: Balloon Blast 10.13.2020
notes.content:
[h3][b]-Text chat[/b][/h3]
   You can access text chat by pressing enter. Send your ggs and very cheerful messages to everyone in the lobby! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38794374/1128111edb840b18b822530cd5bf59316a93b577.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38794374/f0ad2ddf708cb5fe649cf708c51f4ad7c0b4c96b.jpg[/img]

So excited for launch!! Only 23 more days :D

notes.title: Balloon Blast Update
notes.content:
[b]-Fixed a bug that allowed you to skip backward into negative time in replays. [/b]
       -As much fun as negative time was the physics team here was very concerned with causing temporal anomalies

[b]-Made the replay bar smaller[/b]
   -It was just too darn big. It was originally designed for a scrubber bar and two extra buttons which didn't make into that version. Maybe one day. 

[b]-Spectators now show up in the player list (tab screen) [/b]
    -If someone were spectating they weren't showing up in the player list meaning they couldn't be kicked. No no one is safe from the ban hammer. 

[b]-Switching from spectator back to player will now teleport you back to world spawn[/b]
    -Before this fix a player could theoretically switch to spectator fly down to the map then switch back before round start. But no one would've done that... Right? 

[b]-Net code improvements[/b]
-Sending as little to the server as possible while slightly reducing the tick rate on some objects to hopefully improve on latency. 

[b]-Fixed a bug that would cause the mouse sensitivity to scale with time dilation while watching replays[/b]
